home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and optical exposed as separate channels (optical Channel 1 / thermal Channel 2).

release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD2637T-10 is a thermal & optical bi-spectrum network bullet camera pairing a 384x288 uncooled VOx thermal detector (9.7 mm lens) with a 4 MP (2688x1520) optical channel, aimed at perimeter protection and early fire prevention. It offers high-accuracy thermography-grade temperature measurement (-20 to 550 C), dynamic fire detection and VCA analytics. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet DS-2TD2637T-10_QY_Datasheet_20250923.pdf.
